The guided lessons in problems/guided-2000-3000.json and
problems/guided-3000-4000.json include adapted algorithm
implementations. Each entry records its origin and license in `provenance`.

MIT entries: LeetCode solutions by Peng-Yu Chen (walkccc) and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/walkccc/LeetCode
Copyright (c) 2022 Peng-Yu Chen. Full license: walkccc-MIT-LICENSE.txt.

CC-BY-SA-4.0 entries: doocs/leetcode contributors.
Source: https://github.com/doocs/leetcode
Full license: doocs-CC-BY-SA-4.0-LICENSE.txt.
The adapted code/reference query in those entries remains available under
CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Local modifications include normalized formatting/type annotations, judge API
adapters, runnable examples, SQLite dialect adaptations, corrected upstream
defects, current problem-interface updates and teaching-oriented algorithms.
JavaScript/TypeScript solutions are transpiled and instrumented for an isolated
V8 execution context with a deterministic virtual clock. Native Python/Pandas
code uses a separate local environment. Source descriptions are not copied
into the application; examples are structured data used to verify execution.

The interactive scenes, Vietnamese explanations, source instrumentation,
runtime integration and regression/property checks are local additions.
